entry.title: Frozen Flows Forget: Diagnosing and Restoring Lost Motion in a Latent-flow World Model
entry.summary: Latent world models that integrate a flow in a frozen self supervised latent space train stably and cheaply, yet silently lose the property manipulation depends on most: motion. entry.title: ROAM-ASD: Robust Open-World Active Speaker Detection with Flexible Multimodal Fusion
